issue: Candidate namesake affiliations could enter a confirmed person's history.
root_cause: The affiliation filter tested the person's best identity globally instead of requiring a probable or confirmed identity bridge on the affiliation's own source.
correction: Removed unsupported namesake ORCID affiliations and required a source-local identity bridge.
prevention: Dataset validation now rejects every structured affiliation without a probable or confirmed identity on the same source URL.

issue: An active Doctoral Researcher was displayed as employment rather than as a PhD student.
root_cause: The role classifier recognized PhD Student and Doctoral Candidate but not Doctoral Researcher.
correction: Classified active doctoral-researcher roles as education and published Khalifa University / PhD Student in Biomedical Engineering.
prevention: Regression tests distinguish doctoral researchers from postdoctoral researchers; validation rejects active doctoral-researcher employment destinations.

issue: A completed PhD role remained the current destination after the January 2026 defense.
root_cause: The accepted LinkedIn experience heading was stale and no newer official destination review had overridden it.
correction: Superseded the doctoral role with University of Luxembourg / Postdoctoral Researcher from 2026.
prevention: Every extractable LinkedIn current organization must now match the published destination or have an explicit destination/source-precedence review.

issue: DESY was presented as an open-ended current role even though its current staff page lists the person under Alumni.
root_cause: An open-ended ORCID affiliation and the word Scientist outweighed the alumni section semantics.
correction: Bounded the DESY scientist outcome to 2015-2024 and labeled its Hamburg location last verified in 2024.
prevention: Validation rejects alumni-labeled current destinations; historical destination locations carry a last-verified year.

issue: An undated Premix Pro summary displaced an explicit current founder role.
root_cause: The old manual summary had no end date and was therefore ranked as current despite its source not establishing current employment.
correction: Superseded it with MUSAB / CONTROLS / Managing Director and Founder from 2014.
prevention: Accepted-profile current organizations are reconciled against the final destination and unexplained mismatches fail validation.

issue: The profile's Center for Pedagogical Measurements employer did not match its Nazarbayev Intellectual Schools destination.
root_cause: The organization registry lacked the profile's long-form subsidiary-under-parent wording.
correction: Mapped both quoted and unquoted Center for Pedagogical Measurements forms to Nazarbayev Intellectual Schools (NIS).
prevention: A normalization regression test covers the exact public-profile wording; the reconciliation table uses canonical organization names.

issue: Six accepted profiles exposed short programs, stale roles, concurrent roles, or ambiguous overlapping employers that differed from the single published destination.
root_cause: A single destination cannot be selected mechanically when profile headings conflict with newer official evidence or concurrent affiliations.
correction: Recorded an explicit per-person source-precedence decision, retaining active degree status or the strongest newer/current official source.
prevention: Validation requires a destination review or URL-specific outcome decision whenever an accepted profile's parsed current organization differs from the published destination.

issue: The outcome omitted the exact current teaching role and university history despite direct institutional sources.
root_cause: The earlier source set did not combine the employer's current staff report with the university's thesis repository.
correction: Published NIS Physics Teacher as the destination and Nazarbayev University as alma mater with Kazakhstan location evidence.
prevention: Destination and alma-mater builders retain distinct official sources; regression coverage fixes the role and institution.

issue: Two published destinations matched the profile employer but retained a generic or ended role title.
root_cause: Organization-only reconciliation treated a same-employer match as sufficient and did not compare the selected role against dated current profile roles.
correction: Published Anuar's 2024 Sports Financing Model Project consultant role and Nurlan's 2025 WHO Cyprus consultant role.
prevention: The LinkedIn reconciliation now audits current roles separately from organizations and validation rejects unexplained same-employer role mismatches.

issue: Four education records ending in 2026 conflicted with history-only, incoming-university, or post-graduation outcomes.
root_cause: A bounded education record remains active through its graduation year, but dates alone cannot establish whether the person is still enrolled, has graduated, or has a newer destination.
correction: Recorded source-specific decisions preserving two history-only rows, Nurgul's officially confirmed incoming MIT destination, and Rakhim's post-graduation Desargues AI headline.
prevention: Bounded active education now participates in reconciliation and every conflict requires an explicit source-precedence decision.
